pages.text:
Meridian Pte Ltd and Cloudline Pte Ltd

The term runs from 1 December 2025 to 30 November 2026.

The subscription renews for one year unless either party gives written notice at least 60 calendar days before 30 November 2026.

Either party may terminate for a material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

S$40,000 annually, payable within 30 days of invoice.

Aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

Neither party shall disclose the other party’s confidential information.

Meridian Pte Ltd and Northstar Trading Pte Ltd

The term runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026.

The agreement expires on 31 December 2026 unless renewed in writing.

Either party may terminate for a material breach not remedied within 30 days of written notice.

S$8,000 monthly, payable within 30 days of invoice.

Aggregate liability shall not exceed S$50,000.

Meridian appoints Northstar as its exclusive distributor for the Atlas product in Singapore during the term.

Meridian Pte Ltd and Harbour Retail Pte Ltd

The term runs from 1 September 2026 to 31 October 2026.

This agreement does not renew automatically.

Either party may terminate if the other party becomes insolvent.

S$12,000 for the Atlas product, payable on delivery.

Aggregate liability shall not exceed S$12,000.

Meridian shall sell the Atlas product directly to Harbour for resale in Singapore on 15 October 2026.

Meridian Pte Ltd and Studio Eight Pte Ltd

The term runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 October 2026.

Any extension requires a new written agreement.

The tenant may terminate by giving two months’ written notice.

S$4,500 monthly, payable on the first day of each month.

[Illegible text in supplied scan]

The premises may be used only as an office.

conflicts.title: Overlapping distribution commitments
conflicts.summary: Northstar is granted exclusive distribution of Atlas in Singapore. The Harbour agreement commits to direct sales for resale in the same territory during the same period.
conflicts.question: Does the Northstar exclusivity prohibit this direct sale, and are there waivers or amendments permitting the Harbour transaction?
